name: New on Lichtspiel
author: Lichtspiel
description: Collects the movies and episodes added and sends one message a week (or a day) with their posters, by e-mail and/or Telegram. Each person chooses under Settings: their e-mail address, connecting Telegram, or nothing. For e-mail enter an SMTP server (smtp_host, smtp_port, smtp_security: "starttls", "ssl" or "none", smtp_user, smtp_password, smtp_from); for Telegram the token of a bot made with @BotFather (telegram_bot_token). "every": "week" or "day"; "weekday": the day of the weekly message (monday … sunday); "skip_libraries": libraries left out, by name. With the address used in invite links (Settings → General) the titles link to their page.
